verdict.rationale: Canny's official MCP server lets users run Canny through natural language in ChatGPT, Claude, or Cursor. Users can query feedback, themes, ARR impact and the roadmap, and can also act on it: update statuses, link deals, organize requests, reply to customers and send conversations to Autopilot. Missing for 10: any native in-app natural-language command interface (operation depends on an external LLM client), detailed documentation of which actions the MCP tools cover and their limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor marketing pages.
